ingredients.name: baking apples, peeled, cored and sliced
white granulated sugar, for the topping

steps.instruction: Put 6 cups of sliced baking apples in a large saucepan.
Add 2/3 cup of sugar and 4 tablespoons of water, and stir.
Cover and simmer for 5 minutes, until the fruit is tender.
Add 2 tablespoons of water and 1 tablespoon of cornstarch.
Cook, stirring, until the filling is thick and bubbly.
In a medium bowl, stir together 1 cup of flour and 2 tablespoons of sugar.
Stir in 1 1/2 teaspoons of baking powder.
Cut in 1/4 cup of butter until the mixture looks like large crumbs.
In a small bowl, stir together 1 egg and 1/4 cup of milk.
Add it to the flour mixture, just enough to moisten.
Move the filling to a 2-quart square baking dish.
Drop the topping in small mounds on the filling with a large spoon.
Bake in the 400 °F oven for 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake in the 400 °F oven for 20 to 25 minutes.
